public_anchors.diagnostic_scope: Complete calendar-year synthetic observations, including adoption effects and observation noise. Gas includes positive consumers only. Not a real-world predictive validation.

energy.limitations: Meter aggregates are not individual banking records or evidence of adoption. A fitted lognormal is an approximation to published mean and median, not a reconstruction of meter microdata. Simulated adoption effects, missing months and observation noise change generated totals. Gas source year runs mid-May 2024 to mid-May 2025. GB excludes Northern Ireland.
energy.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
energy.title: Subnational electricity and gas consumption summary report 2024
energy.use: Public aggregate statistics anchor synthetic baseline annual demand marginals. Seasonal profiles, customer associations, observations and adoption labels remain synthetic.
